inputs.label: Deterministic standard-code shipped surfaces
inputs.prompt: Run all three supplied standard-code examples twice, execute the focused regression suite twice, and verify the reported CAI result and translated protein.

inputs.label: Vertebrate-mitochondrial table-2 optimization
inputs.prompt: Use genetic-code table 2 to optimize all four TGA/TGG sense-codon and AGA/AGG terminal-stop combinations, and prove that every source and result translates to MW*.

inputs.label: Strict and permissive CDS validation
inputs.prompt: Exercise empty, partial, shifted, ambiguous, internal-stop, and whitespace inputs under the strict validator; then process an ambiguous-plus-partial input permissively and verify exact discarded offsets and shared analysis state.

inputs.label: Biopython 1.85 CAI semantics and guards
inputs.prompt: Verify indexed-stop contribution, family-normalized pseudocounts, strict and non-strict tie behavior, guarded zero-denominator handling, and standard-code protein preservation under Biopython 1.85.

inputs.label: Public thrA and external Nc boundary
inputs.prompt: Validate and analyze the public table-11 E. coli thrA CDS, rerun codonW on heterogeneous and public controls, and confirm that the candidate neither implements nor advertises the removed nonstandard Nc quantity as standard Nc.
